title: U.S. Bank Repossessions Rise 42%: Are Buyers Gaining Leverage?
description:
U.S. bank repossessions rose 42% year over year in August, according to Michael Bordenaro's discussion of foreclosure data. This recap distinguishes nearly 5,800 repossessions from 40,277 properties with filings, notes activity remains below pre-pandemic levels, and covers his household-debt concerns and state comparisons. Next come roughly 1.16 million listings, a 21.1% price-cut share, and his argument for realistic pricing and patient buyer offers. We also discuss his reported 7.56% mortgage rate at filming, not a current quote.

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.
